styleSelection.reason: Full 5-band light-to-dark value ladder with multi-layer middle washes and connected shadow glazes, paired with loose structural opening ink and crisp closing ink accents.

sunlit-winding-trail.reason: Hold bare sunlit paper core along the winding dirt path with warm yellow-ochre and pale olive transitions at the grass verges.

upper-right-grass-slope.reason: Broad sunlit yellow-green hillside wash graded from bright hansa-yellow crest into sap-green midtones.

upper-left-grass-meadow.reason: Warm sunlit green slope flanking the upper bend of the trail.

lower-center-grass-slope.reason: Broad sunlit lower hillside sweeping across the foreground beside the winding path.

top-left-oak-wood.reason: Rounded oak crowns and deep cool slate-olive shadow recesses at the upper left.

central-overarching-oaks.reason: Billowy oak canopy overarching the middle bend of the trail with warm olive midtones and dark branch recesses.

diagonal-wooded-ravine.reason: Dense diagonal belt of oak trees and cool blue-slate shadow masses descending from upper center to right-center.

left-foreground-woods.reason: Deep layered foliage and cool shadow glazes framing the left edge of the trail.

lower-right-tree-cluster.reason: Dark foliage mass and shadow accents anchoring the lower-right corner.

families.referenceCue: Upper-left grove of rounded oak crowns with dark cool-grey and olive shadow hollows.
Sunlit yellow-green grassy bank between the upper-left woods and the upper trail bend.
Lower-right cluster of dark oak foliage and shadow accents framing the bottom of the meadow.
Broad diagonal mass of oak canopies and deep cool blue-slate shadow recesses across the upper-middle and right.
Left-side and central wooded slope with dark olive, warm umber, and cool slate-blue shadow glazes.
Central billowy oak canopy above the trail bend with warm olive-green foliage planes and dark branch recesses.
Sunlit cream and warm ochre-olive trail verges and grassy transition along the winding dirt path.
Bright sunlit yellow-green hillside on the upper-right and middle slope, graded smoothly toward the tree line.
Broad sunlit yellow-green foreground meadow sweeping across the lower center and right.

reserves.reason: Bright sunlit bare-paper core where the dirt trail enters at the top crest.
Reserved paper light at the upper-left bend of the winding path.
Bright sunlit paper core on the middle switchback beneath the overarching oaks.
Sunlit bare-paper highlight along the lower-center stretch of the trail.
Brightest foreground paper reserve on the dirt path before the bottom edge.
